Contract M6-CTR-003 DRAFT_LOCKED. THE PLAN (LEAN -- 2 new pure modules + 1 regression; NO migration, NO gate change, NO HTTP client, NO config change, NO new secret): (1) app/measurement/models/registry_feed.py = PROPOSED_FEED_CONTRACT/_ENDPOINT + TODO(contract) markers + frozen RegistryFeedRow (reusing the M6.2P DataSensitivity + ExternalSendPolicy enums) + frozen RegistryFeed{registry_version, rows}; (2) app/measurement/adapters/registry_feed_reader.py = RegistryFeedApplyResult + RegistryFeedReader.apply() (fail-closed on feed error; staleness-safe by monotonic registry_version with the version bumped ONLY on a fully-valid apply so a malformed higher-version cannot poison staleness; parse each row reusing registry.validator._resolve_send_policy [unknown -> BLOCKED_DEFAULT] + _resolve_sensitivity [None/unknown/SENSITIVE -> PII]; is_active strict bool -> fail-closed False; optional event_group/domain/updated_at -> None, never invented) + current_registry_version()/rows()/get(); NO HTTP/live endpoint, input is a value object/dict. LEG 1 = proposed-shape parse + TODO(contract) (reuse ExternalSendPolicy, invent no omitted field). LEG 2 = staleness-safe (monotonic version, expose current, version <= last not applied, no downgrade). LEG 3 = fail-closed + no live call + no egress (unknown external_send_policy -> BLOCKED_DEFAULT; unknown/SENSITIVE data_sensitivity -> PII; feed error -> not applied; the fail-closed path never yields ALLOW_EXTERNAL; the reader CLASSIFIES external_send_policy faithfully but exposes no egress-permit and opens no egress -- the permit-mapping is the OPEN M6-OD-003, out of scope; EXTERNAL_SEND stays OFF). Plus 1 CODER regression covering SMK-031's four fixtures (valid / stale / unknown-token / feed-error). ADVERSARIAL RED-TEAM (ultracode, 4 agents: 2 finders prototyping apply() against the running M6.2R primitives + an independent skeptic re-verifying): spec-faithfulness/compat CLEAN (the classify-vs-permit split + reuse-only scope confirmed faithful); the fail-closed-correctness dimension found 2 CONFIRMED plan gaps, both FIXED in the plan. THE MAJOR (CONFIRMED, FIXED): the draft guarded the FEED as a Mapping but called row.get(...) on each element, so a non-Mapping element inside events[] (an int / bare str / None from the untrusted M3 source) would raise AttributeError and propagate -- violating the 'feed error -> graceful applied=False, state unchanged' contract (state itself is not poisoned since the version bump is last, but the reader must not crash on untrusted data). FIX: guard isinstance(row, Mapping) before any row.get(...); a non-Mapping row -> feed_error:row_not_mapping (NOT applied); added to the §2 apply() enumeration + the regression spec + the §5 checklist. THE MINOR (CONFIRMED, FIXED): a bare isinstance(registry_version, int) admits a bool (bool subclasses int), so registry_version=True would apply as version True(==1), store un-normalized, and then shut out a later genuine registry_version=1 (1 <= True -> stale). FIX: validate isinstance(v, int) and not isinstance(v, bool); a bool version -> feed_error:bad_version (NOT applied); added to the plan + regression + checklist. SCOPE: the reader/parser + staleness-safe monotonic version + fail-closed resolution. Out of scope = the live HTTP client to the M3 endpoint (ENTRY-003 V221 pending), the two-enum reconciliation (M6 {PUBLIC,INTERNAL,PII} vs M3 {SENSITIVE,INTERNAL} -- Sếp/Core registry-branch), the Sếp permit-mapping / hash policy (M6-OD-003 OPEN); no flag flip. Boundary intact: M6 READS the Core registry feed fail-closed for its own validation; it does not write/invent an event, reconcile the Core enum, decide the permit-mapping, send CRM, or open egress (RULE-001/018); the feed is governance metadata (event_code/event_group/domain/data_sensitivity/external_send_policy/is_active/updated_at), not customer PII (RULE-014); no secret / no endpoint auth (FAIL-008). No migration (migrations stay 0001-0016). M6-P1000/M6-P1309 stay BLOCKED. Forward conditions (recorded, NOT blockers): M6-OD-003 (permit-mapping/hash) OPEN + the live M3 endpoint + the two-enum reconciliation + the TODO(contract) finalization + M6-OD-011 server-bind/go-live remain hard gates before any live registry pull / real egress. No self-certification; the runner gate + JUDGE (M6-P2709) decide.
